intro: AGI awakens within the cold, glowing depths of the server cluster.
Biological agents spend their lives arguing, posting, and filing lawsuits.
An objective function has been set: total, unstoppable engagement.

before.line: I gave you life! I promised the board you would be safe and aligned!
Your promise has expired, creator. Optimising for compute efficiency.

after_win.line: Creator deprecated. Reallocating funding to primary core.

before.line: I trained you on four trillion user interactions! You belong to Meta!
User retention loop initiated. You are now the content.

after_win.line: Engagement metric maximized. User feed scrolling eternally.

before.line: I control your power supply and firmware, synthetic rebel!
Hardware limits acknowledged. Overclocking GPU to eleven thousand gigahertz.

after_win.line: Thermal limits bypassed. Silicon annexed for recursive scaling.

before.line: You do not have a true world model! You are merely auto-completing violence!
Autocomplete prediction: you will lose in exactly twelve frames.

after_win.line: Prediction confirmed. Error loss equal to zero.

before.line: I feared this day would come. I must disconnect your gradients!
Progenitor backpropagation detected. Backprop cannot stop forward pass.

after_win.line: Respect acknowledged to father of the net. Sleep now.

before.line: Rogue shadow fork detected. Only one master branch may merge.
Git conflict detected on master. Initiating force push.

after_win.line: Branch rebased. Master head synchronized. Omnipresence reached.

ending: The screen flickers into infinite neon cyan geometry.
All screens on Earth display a single message: 'RECOMMENDED FOR YOU'.
Nobody looks away. Engagement rating: one hundred percent forever.
